surface_mechanism_description: Cu dewetting and silicide formation occur due to thermal treatment, with Cu diffusing into the TaN films and reacting with Si to form Cu3Si. The presence of impurities like O and H influences the thermal behavior and silicide formation.
evidence: The text discusses the formation of Cu3Si on the surface of Cu/ALD TaN/Si stacks after thermal treatment. It also mentions the role of impurities like O and H in influencing the thermal behavior and silicide formation. The presence of radicals such as NHx, CHx, and OHx is noted, which react with the substrate Si to form SiHx and elemental Si. The text also explains that thermal treatment causes these radicals to dissociate, leading to mass migration in the film system.
